summary: The five required optional counters and recovery fields are explicitly present with correct numeric/bool types in all15 preserved health samples across three original observer receipts. Collector source/prefix SHA reconstruction matches each receipt. These are numeric-preserving filtered copies of actual GET /health results, not values inferred from a final checkpoint, synthetic fixture, last_native_report or default0. The internal NativeDpuSchedule implementation body remains unavailable in the inspected local source corpus.

normal_stop_contract.behavior: The existing dry-run already checks each counter by explicit indexing/type/nonnegative value and preserves actual optional objects into the stop intent. No new Native or C read implementation is required for these keys.

source_projection.stage: Native scheduler installed into camera state
source_projection.projection: Original attach constructs NativeDpuSchedule(context, inherited_optional=aux.get('inherited_optional'), inherited_sface_counters=aux['sface_counters'], ...). ui_camera_service.run installs the returned schedule into state.dpu_schedule. This establishes the Native schedule branch rather than the fallback scheduler.

source_projection.stage: Public camera health field and route
source_projection.projection: GET /health responds with state.health(). The dpu_schedule field is exactly self.dpu_schedule.health() if configured. Handler JSON-serializes that object with Cache-Control:no-store. No optional counter is manufactured in CameraState.health or the route.

source_projection.remaining_source_gap: No exact body/line numbers for NativeDpuSchedule.health or optional_status; cannot complete source-level proof of their internal accumulator/update/native-array mapping. A manifest SHA is not a substitute for that body. Actual archived HTTP exposure is nevertheless independently established by the preserved responses below.

source_projection.stage: Original passive observer preserves response numbers without defaults
source_projection.projection: get(8790,'/health') obtains the JSON object. health() passes its dpu_schedule directly through numbers(schedule). numbers iterates only existing dictionary items and copies each int/float/bool/None unchanged; it does not add missing keys, sum reports, rename native_completed or supply0. Non-numeric phase strings are filtered out, but the required recovery integers/bool are preserved.
source_projection.receipt_code_hash_check: Reconstructed exact host prefix EXPECTED = repr({camera_pid,gui_pid,gtk_pid}) plus the LF-normalized saved collector text; SHA matches all three stored collector_sha256_lf values. No collector or HTTP function was executed during this audit.

recovery_evidence.all15_samples_both_tasks: faults/attempts/recoveries/probe_successes explicitly present, type int, nonnegative; history_opaque explicitly present, type bool
recovery_evidence.why_zero_is_not_a_missing_default: The collector iterates existing keys and copies raw values; the audit checked membership before checking type/value. These zeros came from the recorded API response. They are not new lower bounds for any future run.
recovery_evidence.single_operation_report_separation: Every examined task object separately has last_native_report. Its submitted/completed values in first samples are1/1, while top-level calls/native_completed are thousands and can advance across samples. The audit uses the top-level keys only and never reconstructs cumulative values from last_native_report.

direct_reusable_readonly_entry.entry: Existing loopback GET /health on camera port8790, through the original HTTP handler and CameraState.health
direct_reusable_readonly_entry.future_use: Reuse the already reviewed normal-stop default dry-run or its bounded metadata GET under the authorized future owner window. Read actual optional and feature counters from this response; do not instantiate NativeContext, call a new C reader, or execute the entire40s observer just to obtain one snapshot.

remaining_gates: Fresh actual boot/PID/birth/cmd, full current source/config closure and Native ABI remain mandatory in the later default dry-run.
Require the keys/types again in that real response; missing/changed source -> HOLD before stop. Archived values must never populate fresh expected or prestop lower bounds.

The internal native_schedule.py body at the exact dd42 SHA is still needed if the caller requires a complete source-level proof of accumulator semantics or exact mapping to Native seed arrays. This audit proves public exposure from preserved responses and route/collector source, not that unavailable implementation body.
Existing normal-stop/final/history/marker/ownership gates remain unchanged; this audit is not a live maintenance pass or device handoff.

local_search_scope.plain_sources: Read-only search of current deployment source archives plus shared aura/project source trees found no NativeDpuSchedule or optional_status body.
local_search_scope.zip_result: No native_schedule.py or dpu_vision_schedule.py member in those source archives. No media/DB/key archive member was opened or extracted.
